cycles.summary: Authored the contract-playbook-review skill to the standard Lawcal legal-tech package, merging the 'Contract Playbook Review' and 'Playbook Reviewer' concepts into one skill: SKILL.md (English), SKILL_HE.md (Hebrew mirror), two references (playbook-structure, grading-rubric), an offline stdlib-only clause/trigger scanner, metadata.json, evidence.json, and this log. The skill's central discipline is that a playbook entry is never compliance on its own (the actual clause language must fall inside a stated band), escalation triggers are orthogonal to the position grade, and the firm's positions are never invented where the playbook is silent. Ran the script self-check (--selftest: OK) on python3.12.

changes.detail: Authored SKILL.md: playbook loading, clause extraction and mapping, the at-target/within-fallback/off-playbook/redline-breach grading rubric, the orthogonal escalation-trigger layer, the deviation/negotiation worklist, anti-fabrication discipline, three examples, gotchas, reference links, and troubleshooting.
Added SKILL_HE.md: Hebrew RTL mirror of the instructions, examples, gotchas, reference links, and troubleshooting.

Added references/playbook-structure.md (target vs fallback band vs hard redline vs escalation trigger, per-term entries, owners, loading by contract type) and references/grading-rubric.md (grading rules, orthogonal escalation layer, grade-DOWN-when-unsure, deviation-report format).
Added metadata.json (author, version 1.0.0, category, bilingual tags + display name/description, supported agents).
Added evidence.json documenting 5 claims sourced to the method references, playbook-structure guidance, WorldCC/IACCM negotiated-terms research, and the local script self-check.
Verified scripts/clause_scanner.py --selftest passes on python3.12 (stdlib only, no network).

deferrals.reason: Judging whether a clause's actual language falls inside a fallback band requires reading the clause against the firm's real playbook positions, which is outside a static pattern scanner's ability. The script deliberately stops at topic tagging plus redline/trigger signal detection and defers band grading to the human/agent with the playbook, per the anti-fabrication rule.

A machine-readable playbook schema (per-term target/fallback/redline/trigger records the scanner could auto-map against) was not built; the current pass loads the playbook via human reading of references/playbook-structure.md. A structured ingestion format is a possible future enhancement.
